name: Рыцарский фонарик
alt: Маленький фонарик на рыцарском шлеме ослепляет самого любопытного мотылька.
prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset: one square original illustration for a humorous fantasy card game, readable at 384x384. Funny expressive caricature, bold clean ink contours, loose watercolor and gouache on warm lightly mottled parchment, saturated colors, chunky simple forms, strong silhouette. Large centered subject with comfortable margins, minimal scenery, one visual joke. No text, letters, numbers, logos, watermark, border, card frame or panels. Original composition, do not copy existing card art. Clear anatomy, no duplicated limbs. Subject: One battered steel medieval knight helmet with a small warm glowing brass lantern cleverly strapped on top by a brown leather band. Lantern has a little pointed knightly visor like a tiny helmet, lit yellow glass inside; the main helmet's eye slit lies below it. One tiny cross-eyed moth with two antennae hovers in the glow, comically dazzled. Helmet sits on a plain stone, no human head or body, no modern electronics.
